request: Investigate the delay on order ORD-1011.

steps.text: I will look up the order details to see its fulfillment status, warehouse, items, and promised delivery date.
I will check the shipment tracking to confirm if it is overdue and whether the carrier recorded a delay or if tracking has stalled.
I will submit the final report with the findings, evidence, cause, and recommended actions.

arguments.summary: The order is overdue by 2 days because the warehouse dispatched it 4 days after the ship-by date, making the 2026-03-14 promise unachievable. The shipment is currently in transit with a carrier ETA of 2026-03-17.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1011 fulfillment_status SHIPPED; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-14; fulfillment_warehouse_id WH-ATL.
get_shipment_status: SHP-5011 via Harbor Express tracking HBX-12077 status IN_TRANSIT; dispatch_date 2026-03-13; ship_by_date 2026-03-09; dispatched_late true (dispatch_days_after_ship_by 4).
get_shipment_status: promised_delivery_date 2026-03-14; is_overdue true; days_past_promised_date 2; current_estimated_delivery_date 2026-03-17; recorded_delay_reason null.
get_shipment_status: last event 2026-03-15 at Richmond, VA; days_since_last_event 1.
arguments.likely_cause: Warehouse dispatched the shipment 4 days after the ship-by date (2026-03-13 vs 2026-03-09), so delivery after the 2026-03-14 promise became inevitable.
uncertainties: Whether Harbor Express will meet the current ETA of 2026-03-17 is not yet confirmed.

recommended_actions.details: Inform Wide World Importers that shipment HBX-12077 is in transit but overdue by 2 days; current ETA is 2026-03-17 (get_shipment_status: is_overdue true; current_estimated_delivery_date 2026-03-17). Explain it shipped late from WH-ATL on 2026-03-13 vs ship-by 2026-03-09 (dispatch_days_after_ship_by 4). Provide tracking link and apologize for the delay.

Ask WH-ATL to investigate why ORD-1011 was dispatched on 2026-03-13, four days after the ship-by date 2026-03-09 (get_shipment_status: dispatched_late true, dispatch_days_after_ship_by 4), and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

arguments.recommendation: Notify the customer with the updated 2026-03-17 ETA and escalate to WH-ATL to address the late dispatch that caused the missed promise.
